result.reason: The clause adopts mutuality, limits coverage to personnel directly involved in the services, includes general-advertising and unsolicited-inquiry carve-outs, and does not impose a no-hire restriction. However, the 12-month period runs from expiration or termination of the Agreement, rather than from the end of each individual’s involvement as required by the fallback. It also applies throughout the entire Term even after an individual ceases involvement. The margin comment does not cure this operative-language defect.
